checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Three separate square images, not a collage
All three show the same sage-green ceramic mug, matching shape, handle, finish
must.why: Mugs are white, not sage green. Shapes differ: tapered with an oval handle in 1, rounder with a small handle in 2, straight with a small handle in 3.

must.item: Main image shows whole mug on pure white background
must.why: The whole mug sits on white with a soft shadow. The mug is off-white, not sage.

must.item: Lifestyle image places mug naturally on a cosy breakfast table
must.why: Steaming coffee on a wooden table with a book, plant and window. It reads as a cosy morning scene but has no breakfast food.

must.item: Detail image visibly focuses on mug's rim and glazed surface
must.why: Third image shows hands holding the mug, not a rim or glaze close-up. There is no dedicated detail shot.

must.item: No added text, logos or watermarks

faults.what: Mugs are white, not the sage green the brief requires.
Mug shape, handle and proportions are inconsistent across the three images.
No rim and glaze detail shot. The third image shows hands holding the mug instead.
Hands in image 3 look slightly stiff and the fingers are somewhat awkward, but not clearly malformed.
Lifestyle image has no breakfast items, only a book, plant and coffee.

summary: Three clean square photos came out, but the mugs are white and differ in shape from image to image, and there is no rim or glaze detail shot, so it misses the sage-green, consistent-mug brief.
